mentions.name: Kanji Palace
mentions.description: This app helps people learn Japanese with AI, offering visual mnemonic images, a JLPT progress tracker, and Kanji infographics. Users can also browse Kanji characters sequentially to memorize them, and AI-comic creation based on selected Kanji characters is planned.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I'm working on Kanji Palace (https://kanjipalace.com).

It's an app to learn Japanese language with AI. It has visual mnemonic images, JLPT progress tracker, Kanji info graphic, etc.

Later, I will add AI-comic creation based on Kanji characters you've selected.

mentions.name: KanjiPalace
mentions.description: This app helps users memorize Japanese Kanji and vocabulary using AI-generated visual and story mnemonics. It includes a Kanji writing practice feature and generates AI comics based on vocabulary the user has learned, available on web and iOS.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I'm building an app that helps users memorize Kanji and vocabulary with AI-generated visual and story mnemonics.

Right now, I'm adding a feature to practice writing Kanji and another that creates AI comics based on vocabulary you've learned.
